# Bothell & Woodinville Dispatch

> The Bothell & Woodinville Dispatch is a free weekly email newsletter about Bothell and Woodinville, WA, sent Thursdays at 6 AM Pacific and published by Neighborhood Press LLC. It covers city council decisions, land-use and permit notices, road and transit changes, school district news, openings and closings, with one section per neighborhood. Every item links its public source. It is researched and written with AI tools, and an editor reads every issue before it goes out.

## Key pages
- [This week in Bothell & Woodinville](https://www.bothellwoodinvilledispatch.com/this-week/): the dated items for the current week, updated every Thursday
- [Standards](https://www.bothellwoodinvilledispatch.com/standards/): publisher, sources, sponsors, corrections
- [Subscribe](https://www.bothellwoodinvilledispatch.com/): free, one email a week

## Neighborhoods
- [Downtown Bothell](https://www.bothellwoodinvilledispatch.com/downtown-bothell/): Main Street and the blocks along Bothell Way NE, with the Park at Bothell Landing on the Sammamish River and the Sammamish River Trail.
- [Westhill](https://www.bothellwoodinvilledispatch.com/westhill/): The hill west of downtown, rising from Bothell Way NE and the Sammamish River north toward the county line at NE 205th Street.
- [Waynita / Norway Hill](https://www.bothellwoodinvilledispatch.com/waynita-norway-hill/): South of the Sammamish River and west of I-405: Norway Hill, Blyth Park on West Riverside Drive and the former Wayne Golf Course, now city parkland.
- [North Creek](https://www.bothellwoodinvilledispatch.com/north-creek/): East of I-405 along North Creek and NE 195th Street, with the North Creek Trail, the restored North Creek wetlands and the office parks of North Creek Parkway.
- [Canyon Park](https://www.bothellwoodinvilledispatch.com/canyon-park/): Where I-405 meets the Bothell–Everett Highway on the Snohomish County side, with the Canyon Park business park, the park-and-ride and North Creek running through.
- [Thrasher's Corner / Red Hawk](https://www.bothellwoodinvilledispatch.com/thrashers-corner/): The crossroads of the Bothell–Everett Highway and SR 524 (Filbert Road), with Red Hawk's streets to the east.
- [Woodinville Town Center](https://www.bothellwoodinvilledispatch.com/woodinville-town-center/): Downtown Woodinville around NE 175th Street and 133rd Avenue NE, with City Hall, Wilmot Gateway Park and the Sammamish River Trail.
- [Tourist District](https://www.bothellwoodinvilledispatch.com/tourist-district/): Woodinville wine country along NE 145th Street and the Woodinville–Redmond Road, with Chateau Ste. Michelle, the Hollywood Schoolhouse and the Sammamish River Trail.
- [Reinwood Leota](https://www.bothellwoodinvilledispatch.com/reinwood-leota/): Northeast Woodinville's wooded streets around Lake Leota and 168th Avenue NE, north of the Woodinville–Duvall Road.
- [Cottage Lake](https://www.bothellwoodinvilledispatch.com/cottage-lake/): Unincorporated King County east of Woodinville, around Cottage Lake, Cottage Lake Park and Bear Creek, off the Woodinville–Duvall Road and Avondale Road NE.
